items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer edit. Repaint game card 花开两面. Image1 is the edit target and ABSOLUTE COMPOSITION authority: preserve its frontal centered waist-up woman, face position/scale, both hands clasping the same vertical flower stem at lower center, blossom in front of chest, long hair flowing down both sides, and simple background divided vertically into warm beige gold left and deep green right. Keep the flower's left half pale cream above and wilted dark red/black below, right half bright ivory gold petals, divided down its vertical center. Do not change pose, crop, flower scale, gesture or background split. Image2 is Baita CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only: calm feminine face with clear green eyes, deep brown very long wavy hair in large locks, white long-sleeved blouse and dark green suspender dress. Do NOT import its seated pose, chair, books, cake or magic circle. Preserve the card's earrings and small blue throat brooch as simple accents. Rough hand-painted anime color study: large connected opaque color masses, few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, hard handmade shadow shapes, matte muted colors with concentrated green-eye and golden-flower accents. Resolve face, eyes and two hands clearly; reduce fine curly strands into substantial wavy locks, blouse into principal folds and broad shadow planes, petals into readable broad overlapping masses. Sparse structural linework, quiet coarse regions, no uniformly fine outlines, dense tiny curls/wrinkles, glossy rendering, fragmented facet mosaics or texture filter. Square illustration, no text/frame/watermark/UI.
